svg.text: vcm_rb: replica bias for the pads' internal common mode (S2D vcm = D2S vref)
vcm_rb: replica bias for the internal common mode of the custom pads: S2D vcm = D2S vref (= D2S input common mode).
Task docs/launch/replica_bias_TASK.md (branch harness-test); targets and evidence docs/replica_bias/SURVEY.md, design
vcm sits at the centre of the band in which both pads stay linear (INL <= 2 mV with +-0.5 V on the unit gates):
top edge = the gate voltage at which a unit_r2 tail (hv PMOS 5u/6u at vbp, 5 uA) leaves saturation as the input
follower (hv PMOS 20u/1u ng=2) raises its source;
bottom edge = the output voltage at which the S2D fold cascode CX / CY (hv NMOS 30u/3u at vbnc) leaves saturation
Replicas, each from the block's own lines (made from one 5 uA reference current, as bias_tree_pd does):
gh = top-edge detector: TR (5u/6u at vbp) -> MR (20u/1u ng=2, diode) -> sink SH (2 x 2.4u/6u = 4 uA, r = 0.8)
gh = top gate limit + 0.157 V (+-18 mV over corners, -40..125 C, iovdd 3.0..3.6 V, run explore_edges.py)
xp = fold-node replica: one finger of CY (15u/3u at vbnc) at 5 uA on SY (6u/6u)
m = average of gh and xp by three identical hv PMOS diodes 1u/4u in their own wells, one above m, two in parallel
below (the asymmetry subtracts the 0.06 V offset of (gh + xp)/2 against the centre; explore_vcm_rb.py, G)
vcm = m, buffered by a 5-transistor OTA in unity gain: PMOS pair = the unit's input device (20u/1u ng=2) on a
unit tail (5u/6u at vbp, 5 uA), NMOS mirror 6u/6u; output pole at vcm with CB (12u x 12u hv NMOS capacitor
Lines: NI (6u/6u NMOS diode, the reference), BP (2u/6u PMOS diode at 2 uA from NBP 2.4u/6u = BP's density in the
tree), BNC (1u/8u NMOS diode at 2 uA from PBNC 2u/6u, as in the tree).
Supply current (tt 27 C): 5 uA reference + 2 (BP) + 2 (BNC) + 5 (TR) + 5 (CY) + 5 (OTA) = about 24 uA.
Ports: vdd vss iref vcm en_3v3 en_3v3_b (as oa_core_pd: en_3v3_b from en_ctrl_3v3). iref: 5 uA SOURCED into the
block (bias_gen_pd's iref, a bias_dist_pd output, or a core's iout).
Disabled (en_3v3 = 0): TGN / TGP open the reference, TDN pulls ni to vss (every NMOS off; BP pulls vbp to vdd, every
PMOS off), SPD pulls vcm to vss. The s2d pad ties its outputs to vcm while it is off; whoever disables this block
must disable every pad that uses vcm with it (vcm is the next stage's common mode while only the s2d pad is off).
drawn from netlist/source/vcm_rb.spice; make check-sheet netlists this sheet and compares it with that netlist device by device
